question: RB 12.3 requires a Supply Path to the land zone the unit is in. Should upgrades of units aboard ships at sea, which are in no land zone, be barred?

rule_sources.RB 12.3: rulebook PDF page 80: an upgrade needs a Supply Path to the land zone of the unit receiving it
rule_sources.RB 11.5: rulebook PDF pages 77-78: a ship in port is located in the land zone of its Naval Facility

engine_change.added_condition: the unit's zone is a land zone (s.territories), checked before the Supply Path
callers: placements: unit_upgrade project, any suitable unit
placements: project with a target: flag
engine_change.lend_lease_militia_upgrade: unchanged: already placed only on a militia in a land zone of the recipient's Home Country (RB 12.4)

mutations_caught.land-zone condition dropped: Upgrade offered to a unit aboard a ship at sea, which is in no land zone (RB 12.3)
mutations_caught.every carried unit barred instead: Militia aboard an air transport may become infantry

carried_upgrades.counted: once per carried unit and round
